## Project Overview

Super Soakerz was a student-led car window washing business created as part of a marketing course at Cal Poly Pomona. The project gave my team the opportunity to build a small service brand from the ground up and promote it to students on campus.

The campaign focused on convenience, affordability, and student-to-student trust. Since many Cal Poly Pomona students commute, our team wanted to create a service that felt useful, quick, and easy to access.

---

## Project Goal

The goal of this project was to create a simple service brand that could attract student customers and communicate value clearly.

Our main goals were to:

- Build awareness for the Super Soakerz brand
- Promote a student-led service on campus
- Identify a clear target audience
- Create messaging that felt simple and relatable
- Encourage students to try the service

---

## Target Audience

The primary target audience was Cal Poly Pomona commuter students.

This audience made sense because many students drive to campus and may not always have time to clean their cars. A quick and affordable window washing service could be useful for students who wanted their cars to look cleaner without spending too much time or money.

---

## Brand Positioning

Super Soakerz was positioned as a convenient, affordable, and student-run service.

The brand was meant to feel:

- Easy to approach
- Budget-friendly
- Helpful for busy students
- Simple and direct
- Connected to the campus community

---

## Marketing Strategy

The marketing strategy focused on making the service easy for students to understand.

Instead of using complicated messaging, our team focused on clear benefits:

- Quick service
- Affordable pricing
- Convenient campus access
- Student-run business
- Visible before-and-after results

This helped communicate why students should care about the service.

---

## Campaign Execution

Our team promoted Super Soakerz through campus interaction, word-of-mouth, and visual marketing. We focused on reaching students directly and explaining the value of the service in a simple way.

The campaign included:

- Creating a service concept
- Developing brand messaging
- Promoting the service to students
- Communicating with potential customers
- Using visuals to show service value
- Working as a team to manage the project

## Marketing Lessons Learned

This project helped me understand that marketing is not only about creating a brand. It is also about understanding what customers need and explaining the value in a way that feels clear and useful.

I learned that students are more likely to respond to marketing when the service feels affordable, convenient, and relevant to their daily life.

---

## Key Takeaway

Super Soakerz helped me practice building a marketing campaign from an idea into a real service concept. It strengthened my understanding of target audiences, promotional strategy, customer needs, and brand communication.
